links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance on external cohort
links.effect: With model assistance, radiologists' diagnostic accuracy improved by 16.9% (junior) and 11.1% (senior) in the external cohort; model AUROC 0.916 vs radiologists 0.638.
links.quote: Additionally, with the assistance of the optimized model, radiologists' diagnostic accuracy improved by 16.9% (junior) and 11.1% (senior) in the external cohort.

links.outcome: AI model performance compared against radiologists and 2D models on same data
links.effect: Optimized 3D model AUROC 0.916 versus radiologists 0.638 (p < 0.0001); outperformed four other 3D DL models on external test.
links.quote: Its AUROC was significantly higher than that of radiologists (0.916 versus 0.638; p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing radiologists' diagnostic accuracy with and without AI assistance for calcified thyroid nodule classification.
